exposure: Amplification refractory mutation system quantitative polymerase chain reaction (ARMS-qPCR)
cohort: 10 cases with various neurodegenerative diseases undergoing 13 oocyte retrieval cycles for preimplantation genetic diagnosis.
finding: Preimplantation genetic diagnosis using ARMS-qPCR and/or linkage analysis is a feasible strategy for neurodegenerative diseases, but allele dropout is a concern with ARMS-qPCR alone.
